worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.summary: Sends a ball of purifying rainbow fire along the aim that really stops at the first entity or block: an enemy takes a ranged, non-contact physical fire hit with a good chance to burn; an ally it touches only has its freeze thawed and takes no damage. While frozen the user can still cast it and thaws itself first. The sacred form leaves a rainbow ember field at the impact that never harms allies; the smite form takes one heavier hit.
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.use.0: Send a rainbow fire that stops on the first target
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.use.1: Pressure with a very high burn chance
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.use.2: Thaw the user's own or an ally's freeze
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.use.3: Leave an ember field that only burns enemies
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.description: Sends a rainbow fire %2$s blocks along the aim at %3$s blocks/tick, really stopping at the first entity or block; a hit deals %1$s physical fire damage. It is a ranged, non-contact hit that does not trigger the target's contact recoil.

Hit radius %1$s blocks; a hit has a %2$s chance to burn for about 40 s: every 5 s it loses about 1/16 of its maximum health and its physical attacks deal half damage; Fire-type targets cannot be ignited.

The sacred form leaves a %2$s block rainbow ember field at the impact point, dealing %1$s to those inside every %4$s s and fading after about %3$s; each pulse hits at most %5$s enemies, and allies who step in take no damage.
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.smite.on: Smite: power x1.15 and 6 ticks shorter cooldown, but ignition x0.55 and no lingering flame.
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.smite.off: Sacred: undiminished ignition chance and a rainbow ember field that keeps burning at the impact point, at the cost of slightly lower power and 8 ticks longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %5$s s, costing %4$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.growth.0: From level %1$s the strike rises to %2$s power.
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.growth.1: From level %1$s the strike rises to %2$s power and ignition to %3$s.
On: power x1.15 and 6 ticks shorter cooldown, but ignition x0.55 and no lingering flame - a focused strike. Off (sacred): undiminished ignition chance and a rainbow ember field that keeps burning at the impact point, at the cost of slightly lower power and 8 ticks longer cooldown.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers casting from farther away, and is more willing to run over and thaw an ally.
On: low-health targets rank first, finished with this ranged hit; off: order by ordinary attack only.
worldcombat.skill.sacredfire.description: Casting it first thaws the user's own freeze; if the thrown fire meets an ally first, it only thaws them and never passes through to hit the enemy behind.
